newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Slovnaft, VUB boost SAX index to year-high.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Slovnaft, VUB boost SAX index to year-high.

text.p: Gains to Slovak blue chips Slovnaft and VUB boosted the SAX index to its third consecutive year-high in lively trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
Oil refinery Slovnaft closed up 25 at 900 crowns, while bank VUB fell 70 crowns to 1,730, but traded at a 6.44 percent higher average price to spur the SAX 2.33 points to 199.24.

"A block of 47,000 VUB shares was matched at 1,900 crowns," Dusan Sykora of ING Barings said. "I see this (price) as a fair bonus for such a large package, otherwise the closing price shows the trend better."

VUB posted the biggest volume also in direct trades, with 160,000 shares changing hands at 1,880 crowns, though dealers noted the trades were made several days earlier and only just settling on the bourse now.
Steel maker VSZ closed up two crowns at 697.
Overall volume climbed up to 1.04 million shares, from 377,456 shares traded on Monday, while turnover increased to 1.14 billion crowns, from 228.65 million.
